_meta.description: Seed for v1.10 data model. Mix of realistic and stress-test data: some themes/skills are comfortably within capacity while others deliberately push into over-capacity, projection shortfall, and over-allocated states so v1.10 visual features (grey bands, over-capacity signals, projection shortfalls, cell-background tints) have exemplars to render. BAU = demand of type BAU. Phases can be finite (hours_by_month) or indefinite (steady_state_hours). Requirements are skill-shaped with allocations.
